title: General Rules
items: Every student must carry their official Hostel ID card at all times and present it upon request by the warden or security personnel.
The main gates of the hostel will be closed at 10:00 PM. No student is allowed to enter or leave after curfew without prior approval.
Quiet hours must be strictly observed from 10:00 PM to 06:00 AM to ensure an atmosphere conducive to study and rest.
Residents are expected to keep their rooms and common hostel premises clean and hygienic at all times.

title: Room Rules
items: Rooms are allocated for the academic year and no student should change rooms without formal written permission from the Chief Warden.
Cooking, heating meals, or using heavy electrical appliances (like hot plates, induction cookers, iron boxes, heaters) inside the room is strictly prohibited.
Residents are responsible for the furniture and fixtures provided in their rooms. Any damage will be charged to the occupants.
All electrical lights, fans, and AC units must be turned off when leaving the room to conserve energy.

title: Mess Rules
items: Mess timings must be strictly adhered to: Breakfast (07:30 AM - 09:00 AM), Lunch (12:30 PM - 02:00 PM), Snacks (05:00 PM - 06:00 PM), Dinner (07:30 PM - 09:30 PM).
No food, plates, glasses, or cutlery is allowed to be taken outside the mess hall to the student rooms.
Wastage of food is discouraged and students are requested to take only what they can consume.
Decent dress code and discipline must be maintained inside the dining area.

title: Visitor Policy
items: All visitors, including parents and guardians, must register at the security gate and warden's office before entering the hostel building.
Male visitors are strictly not allowed inside the girls' hostel rooms, and female visitors are not allowed inside the boys' hostel rooms.
Day visitors are permitted only between 09:00 AM and 06:00 PM.
No guest or visitor is allowed to stay overnight in student rooms without written permission from the Warden. Guest charges apply.

title: Gate Pass Policy
items: A valid Gate Pass is mandatory for leaving the campus outside of regular class hours or after the 07:00 PM general curfew.
Local outing gate passes are valid up to 09:30 PM only. Overstaying without notification will result in disciplinary action.
Gate passes must be generated through the portal and approved by the Warden or verified via automated guardian approval before exit.
Students must scan their Gate Pass QR code at the security gate during both exit and reentry.

title: Leave Rules
items: Students wishing to travel home or out of town must apply for a Hostel Leave at least 24 hours prior to departure.
Hostel leave requests will only be approved after verification from the registered parent or guardian via SMS or phone confirmation.
Upon returning from leave, students must sign the register at the warden's office and check back into the hostel portal.
Unapproved absenteeism will be reported immediately to the academic department and parents.

title: Safety & Security
items: Students must lock their room doors whenever they leave, even for a short duration. The management is not responsible for personal belongings.
Keep valuable items like laptops, cash, and documents locked in the wardrobes provided.
Any suspicious activity or unauthorized entry of strangers must be reported immediately to the hostel warden or security desk.
Ragging in any form is a severe criminal offense and is strictly prohibited under government regulations.

title: Prohibited Activities
items: Possession, consumption, or distribution of alcoholic beverages, tobacco products, e-cigarettes, and narcotic substances is strictly prohibited.
No weapons, firearms, knives, or hazardous chemical substances are allowed on the hostel premises.
Playing loud music or creating public disturbance is prohibited, especially during study hours.
Hosting political meetings, campaigns, or distributing unauthorized flyers inside the hostel is not permitted.

title: Disciplinary Actions
items: Violation of any hostel rules will lead to an immediate warning, monetary fine, or reporting to the academic disciplinary committee.
Repeated misconduct or curfew violations will result in suspension or permanent expulsion from the hostel.
The Chief Warden reserves the right to search any room at any time for prohibited items or security audits.
Vandalism or damage to university property will attract a penalty equal to double the repair/replacement cost.

title: Emergency Procedures
items: In case of medical emergencies, immediately contact the assistant warden or activate the SOS trigger on the portal for transport to the health center.
In case of fire, use the nearest fire extinguisher located in the corridors and assemble at the designated fire safety point outside the block.
First aid boxes are available at the warden's desk, security control room, and the gym area.
Emergency contact numbers for ambulance, fire services, and security are posted at all lobby bulletin boards.
